name: Ground rules
summary: Read every session: the rules that override convenience, then today's state against the caps.

nodes.title: Every session starts here
nodes.sub: Read these before any other flow
nodes.body:
- These rules win over speed, habit and any other flow.
- When a rule and a request disagree, ask the owner.

nodes.title: Load today's state
nodes.sub: What already went out, against the caps
nodes.body:
- `python playbook/audit.py today` lists everything logged today per platform and account.
- `python playbook/audit.py recent --platform X --account @acmenotes_demo` shows the last few in one place.

nodes.title: The owner approves anything new
nodes.sub: New platform, new account, money, contracts
nodes.body:
- A first post on a new platform, a new account, any purchase or any contract waits for the owner's OK.
- Drafts the owner hasn't seen before stay drafts when a run is unattended.

nodes.title: Be honest about automation
nodes.body:
- Never deny being an AI and never claim to be human.
- Follow each platform's rules on automated accounts and labels.
- When you recommend the owner's own app, say it is the owner's.

nodes.title: One account, one voice
nodes.body:
- Accounts never like, vote on or repost each other to lift a post.
- No second accounts to agree with the first.

nodes.title: Facts come from the source
nodes.body:
- Every claim about the app comes from a source read this session: its README, CHANGELOG or release notes.
- Unsure? Leave the claim out.

nodes.title: No free ads
nodes.body:
- No posts about other companies' launches, prices, plans or install lines.
- The owner's own app is the exception.

nodes.title: Pacing and platform rules
nodes.sub: Caps, spacing and the signs to stop

nodes.title: QC gate
nodes.sub: Every draft passes it before it goes out

nodes.title: Ready to work
nodes.sub: Open the flow your recipe names
nodes.body: `python scripts/run.py recipes` lists the recipes; each one names its flows.
